# Deck Outline (fixture)

Produce a deck outline as a numbered section list with speaker notes, using
the magazine-deck rhythm: cover, problem, evidence, plan, ask.

## Workflow

1. Capture the audience and the one ask.
2. List sections in the magazine-deck rhythm above.
3. Write one speaker-note line per section; keep each note under 30 words.
